Is knuth1984 a real entry, or a placeholder we still owe a citation for?

replies.body:
Real: `references.bib` carries the entry and its DOI resolves.

I have replied and left the thread open, which is the only thing an agent can do — there is no verb that resolves a comment, so the judgement of whether an answer settles the matter stays yours. An open thread is a decision still owed.

replies.body: It should not. `results/happiness_fit.json` records n = 1, unblinded, by the author of the software — a p-value computed over that would be arithmetic, not evidence. The sentence as written says exactly as much as the data support.
